mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS ship_id, s.name AS ship_name, m.name AS medication_name, l.lot_number AS lot_number, l.remaining_quantity AS remaining_quantity, l.expiry_date AS expiry_date FROM tb_stock_lot l JOIN tb_ship s ON s.id = l.ship_id JOIN tb_medication m ON m.id = l.medication_id WHERE l.status = 'ACTIVE' AND l.remaining_quantity > 0 AND (l.expiry_date < #{today} OR l.expiry_date IN (#{dMinus30}, #{dMinus7})) ORDER BY l.ship_id, l.expiry_date, l.received_at, l.id
